proposed_widenings.name: restrict_action_set
proposed_widenings.justification: Wind Walk's cloud form restricts affected creatures to only two actions (Dash or Magic). The current surface has ActionRestriction as a parameter on grant_extra_action only; no standalone EffectAtom exists for restricting the action economy of an already-existing creature.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The only actions a target can take in this form are the Dash action or a Magic action to begin reverting to its normal form.

proposed_widenings.name: timed_mode_switch_with_condition
proposed_widenings.justification: Wind Walk allows targets to voluntarily revert from cloud form to normal form (and back), but the transition itself takes 1 minute and applies the Stunned condition during the transformation. CastTimeEffectModeChoice supports instant mode switches via magic_action but has no timing delay or transition condition.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Reverting takes 1 minute, during which the target has the Stunned condition. Until the spell ends, the target can revert to cloud form, which also requires a Magic action followed by a 1-minute transformation.

proposed_widenings.name: fall_on_end
proposed_widenings.justification: When the spell ends while a target is in cloud form and airborne, the target descends at a fixed rate (60 ft/round) for a fixed window (1 minute) before falling normally if not landed. The v4 taxonomy lists fall_on_end but it is absent from types.ts EffectAtom.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If a target is in cloud form and flying when the effect ends, the target descends 60 feet per round for 1 minute until it lands, which it does safely. If it can't land after 1 minute, it falls the remaining distance.

notes: Partial encoding is honest: fly-speed grant, prone immunity, and B/P/S resistance all typecheck and trace cleanly. The action restriction (no standalone restrict_action_set EffectAtom) and the timed reversion mechanic (mode switch with 1-minute staging + Stunned during transition) are the core missing pieces. The fall-safe clause is a secondary missing atom (fall_on_end listed in v4 taxonomy but absent from types.ts). CastingTime minutes variant encodes correctly.
